pred_sql:
SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.id
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC
LIMIT 1
